# dimdams_custom_domain (Resource)

Domaine personnel d'un site (un par service). Le domaine doit déjà pointer vers Dimdam's : le panel vérifie le DNS avant de l'accepter. Import : `<host_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dimdams_custom_domain" "www" {
  host_id = "web-1792669078523-xhyuv9"
  domain  = "www.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Nom de domaine, par exemple www.example.com.
- `host_id` (String) Identifiant du service (par exemple vps-1793740523964-d3bw0r).

### Optional

- `target_port` (Number) Port du service visé (port principal par défaut).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ssl_active` (Boolean) Certificat HTTPS en place.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import dimdams_custom_domain.www <host_id>
```
